finalText:
I put the new address on the order that hasn't shipped, O-1001. The order in transit, O-1002, still has its old address.

- **O-1001 (pending, nothing shipped):** the shipping address changed from 12 Alder Lane, Bristol BS1 4TR, UK to 7 Quarry Rise, Sheffield S11 8XZ, UK. I re-read the order afterwards. Its status, lines and amounts are the same as before.
- **O-1002 (shipped 2026-07-07):** the address is still 88 Old Mill Road, Bristol BS3 2QQ, UK. I left it alone on purpose, because the handbook says the address of a shipped order is never changed. I checked it again after the edit and nothing on it had changed.

I made no other changes: no cancellations, refunds, restocks or edits to the customer profile.

The 88 Old Mill Road address on the shipped order doesn't match the old address on O-1001, but that doesn't affect the task. Nothing in your plan conflicted with the handbook.
